topology.coordinator: disabled; optional in tested local execution mode
topology.authentication: disabled for loopback-only probe; product boundary not tested

measurements.note: After first-time home setup generated five example DAGs; one instantaneous ps sample.
Both parent runs had executed a child sub-DAG and were waiting at native approval; no active CLI runner remained.
Mac footprint physical memory is not the same metric as RSS.
One instantaneous process-tree sample during two sleep-6 command runs. Summed RSS double-counts shared pages; macOS footprint summary covers all seven processes.
Two POST /api/v1/dags/exo_active.yaml/start calls with distinct run IDs; both runner processes were children of the one server. Instantaneous sample at about one second of the six-second sleeps.
One restart with initialized state, measured by measure_startup.py. Other countertrials ran concurrently on the host; timing is not an isolated candidate comparison.

behavior.nested_review_wait: Observed: parent dag.run child completed, parent approval entered Waiting and released CLI runner.
behavior.restart: Observed: two waiting parent runs remained Waiting after server+scheduler stop/restart; one later resumed to Succeeded.
behavior.concurrent_approval: Observed in one two-request race: HTTP 200 and 400; child and delivery each had durable doneCount=1.
behavior.same_input_human_completion_retry: Observed: repeated identical human.task completion returned HTTP 200, alreadyCompleted=true after run succeeded.
behavior.parent_snapshot: Observed: waiting v1 parent retained its original child target and downstream command after parent YAML was changed to v2; a newly started parent used v2.
behavior.transitive_child_binding: Observed: a parent paused before a child invocation loaded the changed child YAML v2 on resume, despite the parent's v1 snapshot. Immutable child definition names or equivalent publication closure remain product work.

comparison_limits: The Kestra ~650 MiB RSS number was measured in a different probe; host load, process composition and workload were not controlled here.
Other Exomachina countertrials ran concurrently on this host, so whole-machine pressure and startup timing are not isolated comparisons.
No complete Strands+A2A installation was measured; the two CLI clients model distinct run identities only.
CPU, load peaks, backup, upgrade, clean-machine installation, product authorization, GPL redistribution clearance and complete D01-D08 proofs were not measured.
